name: Badd Bunny Breakout
summary: Play as The Radioactive Chicken Heads for the first time ever, as you take on Badd Bunny and his toxic minions in this epic role-playing quest! Engage in heroic battles with mutant monsters and biohazardous bosses! See all your favorite characters re-imagined in pixel form! Hear all your favorite songs remixed with authentic 16-bit sound! Gain experience and learn awesome new skills as you scour Southern California for your bandmates and join forces to defeat the ultimate furry evil once and for all!
